description: This file declares structures and function prototypes for Levinson recursion used in LPC coefficient calculation, specifically for the AMR speech codec.

methods.name: Levinson_init
methods.description: Initializes a LevinsonState instance, allocating and setting up necessary memory.

methods.name: Levinson_reset
methods.description: Resets the LevinsonState instance to zero, preparing it for reuse.

methods.name: Levinson_exit
methods.description: De-initializes and frees the LevinsonState instance.

methods.name: Levinson
methods.description: Performs the Levinson-Durbin recursion to compute LPC coefficients and reflection coefficients.
